summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made) I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables.  Contrary to the ticket's working hypothesis, I did **not** find a client-side local/anonymous fallback, a missing session check, or a default/shared watchlist_id: - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request (cookies always attached), no localStorage involved. - The watchlist router has its own auth mid
